schema: era-config v0.2 — reference-date registry (read by tools/export-artifacts.mjs)
note: Maps a dated ASPECT slug to the YEAR it anchors to. The export reads this
to give every reference a year, then the centrality heuristic weights it.
Broadened beyond album-only (v0.1) to carry every dated aspect type:
album, event, song, tour, person. Year source for albums is MV's own
`year:` tags (cleaner than post_date for album anchors); events use the
modal post_date year of the artifacts carrying them. Songs inherit their
co-tagged album's year at export time (not enumerated here). `tours` and
`people` are structurally present but SPARSE in the live MV — see
_coverage below. Edited rarely; version-controlled next to era-buckets.json.

_coverage.album: 10/10 dated. 9 strong (dominant year:/post_date signal); rarities is a singles-&-rarities grab-bag spanning 2019–2025 — anchored to its plurality year (2024) but flagged: Mike may prefer it contribute no era.
_coverage.event: 8/8 dated, but values are GENERIC categories (tour, live_show, …), not specific dated events — anchored to modal post_date year, low confidence. Publish date is the real anchor for event-bearing leaves anyway.
_coverage.song: 0 enumerated — songs inherit their co-tagged album's year at export time (every song-tagged track in live MV also carries an album: tag).
_coverage.tour: SPARSE — the tour: namespace is empty in live MV (0 values). Registry kept for forward-compat / Medusa's Disco import.
_coverage.person: SPARSE — only 1 people: tag in live MV, undated. No dated-person anchors today.

medusas_disco.note: phase-anchored to Finding the Sound per spec; spans 2020–2024 in MV

rarities.note: FLAGGED: grab-bag spanning 2019–2025; set year to null to make rarities contribute no era (per v0.1 report proposal)
